About.title: Your reliable VIP chauffeur service in Stuttgart
About.lead: For years we've been getting travellers, business clients and guests to their destination safely, punctually and in style – with a modern Mercedes fleet and professional chauffeurs.
About.storyText: As an owner-run chauffeur service from the Stuttgart region, the guest is at the heart of everything we do. We monitor every flight, plan every ride in advance and guarantee transparent fixed prices – with no hidden costs. Whether an airport transfer, a business trip or a special occasion: you travel relaxed, we take care of the rest.

Services.sectionSubtitle: From airport transfers to VIP limousines.

airport.title: Airport transfer
airport.desc: Punctual pickup and drop-off to all airports in the region.
airport.long: Whether arriving or departing, we get you to Stuttgart Airport and all airports in the region reliably and stress-free. We monitor your flight in real time and are ready on time even in case of delays. Your chauffeur greets you in the arrivals hall with a name sign and helps with your luggage.
includes: Meet & greet with a name sign in arrivals
Fixed price with no hidden costs

event.title: Event & VIP limousine
event.desc: Stylish arrival for weddings, galas and special occasions.
event.long: For weddings, galas, proms or company celebrations we ensure a stylish entrance. Our first-class limousines and professional chauffeurs in suits make every occasion special – punctual, discreet and representative.

corporate.title: Trade show & business
corporate.desc: Reliable transport for companies, trade shows and business trips.
corporate.long: For trade shows, business trips and corporate clients we offer a reliable driving service with a dedicated contact person. Whether a single ride or regular transfers for your team, we ensure a professional process you can rely on.
includes: Group pickup of teams and guests
Transfers to the Stuttgart trade fair grounds

hourly.title: Hourly chauffeur
hourly.desc: Flexible chauffeur by the hour – you set the itinerary.
hourly.long: You set the itinerary – we drive. Book a chauffeur by the hour for several appointments, shopping, sightseeing or business meetings in one day. The vehicle and chauffeur remain exclusively at your disposal the whole time.
includes: As many stops as you like
Ideal for business and city tours

Fleet.sectionSubtitle: The right vehicle for every occasion.

business.name: Business (E-Class)
business.desc: Elegant sedan for up to 4 passengers.
business.long: The Mercedes E-Class is our classic for airport transfers and business trips. Comfortable, discreet and reliable – ideal for up to 4 passengers with suitcases and hand luggage.

first.name: First Class (S-Class)
first.desc: Prestigious luxury-class sedan for up to 4 passengers.
first.long: The Mercedes S-Class stands for the highest comfort and prestige. Generous legroom, fine materials and an especially quiet ride – the first choice for VIPs and special occasions.

van.name: Van (V-Class)
van.desc: Spacious van for up to 8 passengers.
van.long: The Mercedes V-Class van offers room for up to 8 passengers and plenty of luggage. Perfect for families, travel groups or teams who want to travel together in comfort.
van.bestFor: Families & groups with lots of luggage

sprinter.name: Sprinter
sprinter.desc: Minibus for groups of up to 16 passengers.
sprinter.long: The Mercedes Sprinter carries up to 16 passengers plus luggage. The ideal solution for larger groups, clubs and company outings – with no changing vehicles.

Faq.q1: What happens if my flight is delayed?
Faq.a1: We monitor your flight and adjust the pickup time automatically. 60 minutes of waiting time are included.
Faq.a2: Payment is made conveniently in the car – cash or card. No online payment is required.
Faq.a3: Yes. The displayed price is a fixed price with no hidden costs.
Faq.a4: Depending on the vehicle, 4 to 16 passengers. Just choose the right vehicle.
Faq.q5: Can I cancel or change my booking?
Faq.a5: Yes. Cancellations are free of charge up to 24 hours before the ride. We're happy to take changes anytime by phone or email.
Faq.q6: How much luggage can I bring?
Faq.a6: It depends on the vehicle: the E-Class and S-Class take up to 4 pieces, the V-Class up to 8, and the Sprinter up to 16. For oversized items (golf, skis) just let us know.
Faq.a7: Yes. We provide child seats and booster seats free of charge on request. Please note your requirement in the “Notes” field when booking.
Faq.q8: How far in advance should I book?
Faq.a8: For guaranteed availability we recommend at least 24 hours in advance. Short-notice bookings are also possible depending on availability – just give us a call.
